one_line: A 14th‑century nayaka leader remembered for briefly restoring local rule in Warangal after the fall of the Kakatiya kingdom.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s, lean but well-muscled, upright warrior posture
appearance.face: Oval face with medium-brown Deccan complexion, sharp nose, strong jaw, neatly trimmed mustache and short beard outline, calm intense eyes with a determined default expression
appearance.hair: Thick black hair, shoulder-length, gently waved and pulled back into a low knot at the nape; front section parted slightly off-center; wrapped with a narrow maroon cloth headband tied at the back with short loose ends
appearance.costume: Era-accurate mid-14th‑century Deccan warrior attire: a fitted off‑white cotton tunic reaching mid‑thigh with side slits, worn over a simple pale beige inner shirt; a sleeveless dark indigo quilted cotton jerkin as light armor, stitched in small diamond patterns; a wide mustard‑yellow cotton sash wrapped firmly around the waist with one short end hanging to the left; straight dark brown cotton trousers gathered slightly at the ankles; sturdy brown leather sandals with ankle straps; a thin gold chain necklace close to the neck, small round gold stud earrings, and a simple copper armlet on the right upper arm; overall fabrics plain with minimal patterning beyond the jerkin’s quilting.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved Deccan steel sword (talwar-type) with a simple disc pommel and crossguard, carried in a plain dark brown leather scabbard; in hand he draws it partway, showing the bright blade while the scabbard hangs from his sash.

ref_desc: Musunuri Kapaya Nayaka is a lean, medium-brown Deccan warrior with shoulder-length black hair in a low knot and maroon headband, wearing off-white tunic, indigo quilted jerkin, mustard sash, dark brown trousers, leather sandals, simple gold jewelry, and carrying a curved steel sword in a brown scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style historical Deccan warrior as a model sheet for consistent panels: Musunuri Kapaya Nayaka in his mid-30s, lean and upright, with an oval medium-brown face, sharp nose, strong jaw, neat mustache and short beard outline, and calm intense eyes. His thick black hair is shoulder-length, gently waved, pulled into a low knot at the nape, with a narrow maroon cloth headband tied at the back. He wears an off-white cotton tunic to mid-thigh over a pale beige inner shirt, topped by a sleeveless dark indigo quilted cotton jerkin with small diamond stitching as light armor. A wide mustard-yellow sash is wrapped firmly around his waist with one short end hanging to the left, over straight dark brown cotton trousers gathered slightly at the ankles, and sturdy brown leather sandals with ankle straps. Add a thin gold chain necklace, small round gold stud earrings, and a simple copper armlet on his right upper arm; fabrics are plain except the jerkin’s quilting. His signature weapon is a slightly curved Deccan steel sword with disc pommel and crossguard, in a plain dark brown leather scabbard at his sash; show him holding the hilt and drawing the blade partway. Use a palette of medium brown skin, off-white, indigo blue, mustard yellow, dark brown, and maroon, and show front, side, and back views to clearly present face, hair, costume, and sword.
